did: I carried ten of the eleven open Dependabot pull requests in one bucket, pull request 3432, so they cost one round of checks, not ten. It brings the GitHub actions cache, the two Nix actions, clap, regex, rollup, wrangler, vitest and the TypeScript lint tooling up to date, with one lockfile regeneration over all of them. Three fresh-context reviews read it, and every finding was fixed or answered. The Nix actions now install Determinate Nix, so I turned off the FlakeHub cache they would try and fail to reach, and gave the cache keys they write a retention family. Its first run after the update to main went red on a Rust Rounds test that runs out of time when the machine is busy; one re-run was green, and I filed that test as a defect.

calls.title: picomatch for the security fix
options: picomatch 2.3.2, the same fix on the version the change-detection action uses
stay on 2.3.1 and dismiss the advisory
calls.why: The change-detection test copies how dorny paths-filter matches paths, and that action uses picomatch 2; 2.3.2 carries the same fix and matches every one of our patterns the same way.
calls.undo: Set picomatch to 4 with its types in the eslint package and reinstall. Call C1105.

calls.title: Which Nix CI runs
options: Determinate Nix, the installer's new default, with FlakeHub off
upstream Nix, as before, which the installer no longer supports
calls.why: It is the supported default and its own checks were green; FlakeHub off removes an error on every Nix job, since there is no FlakeHub account.
calls.undo: Set determinate to false on the installer in the nix-setup action, and drop the FlakeHub line. Call C1106.

left: The Playwright group, pull request 3231, stays out: its image and Nix pins have to move with it, then the compositions proven on home, which is ask 3431.
The Rust Rounds cap test still runs out of time under a busy machine; issue 3434 holds the fix candidates.
Workflows that set up Nix only after merge, such as trunk and the release ones, first run on Determinate Nix on main.
